# The librarian's definitions govax's STARLET.MLB defines for the LBR$
# routines (docs/PHASE-90 - VMS help.md, subtask 10), and vmsdef's Symbols
# holds (internal/vmsdef/gen -values). Two sources, kept apart:
#
#   - VMS 7.1's own values, printed by LBR90.MAR's first case
#     (vax/round1b/help90.log, "#1 definitions"): LBR$C_CREATE to
#     LBR$C_TYP_SHSTB, and every HLP$M_ name.
#   - The OpenVMS Utility Routines Manual (V7.3), chapter 12: the library
#     types it adds (LBR$C_TYP_NCS to LBR$C_TYP_USRHI); LBR$OPEN's create
#     options array (CRE$, "Offset in Longwords" times 4); and
#     LBR$GET_HEADER's array (LHI$, the same). Unconfirmed on VMS: no run
#     printed them. CRE$C_'s values aren't given there, so they're left out.
#
# The LBR$_ condition values aren't here: they're LBRSHR.EXE's universal
# symbols (vmsdef.ImageSymbols), which LINK resolves.

# $CREDEF
CRE$L_ALLOC = 0x8
CRE$L_ENTALL = 0x14
CRE$L_IDXMAX = 0xc
CRE$L_IDXOPT = 0x20
CRE$L_KEYLEN = 0x4
CRE$L_LUHMAX = 0x18
CRE$L_TYPE = 0x0
CRE$L_UHDMAX = 0x10
CRE$L_VERTYP = 0x1c

# $HLPDEF
HLP$M_GROUP = 0x4
HLP$M_HELP = 0x20
HLP$M_KEYNAMLIN = 0x2
HLP$M_LIBLIST = 0x10
HLP$M_NOHLPTXT = 0x1
HLP$M_OTHERINFO = 0x4
HLP$M_PROCESS = 0x2
HLP$M_PROMPT = 0x1
HLP$M_SYSTEM = 0x8

# $LBRDEF
LBR$C_CREATE = 0x0
LBR$C_READ = 0x1
LBR$C_TYP_EOBJ = 0x7
LBR$C_TYP_ESHSTB = 0x8
LBR$C_TYP_HLP = 0x3
LBR$C_TYP_MLB = 0x2
LBR$C_TYP_NCS = 0x6
LBR$C_TYP_OBJ = 0x1
LBR$C_TYP_SHSTB = 0x5
LBR$C_TYP_TXT = 0x4
LBR$C_TYP_UNK = 0x0
LBR$C_TYP_USRHI = 0xff
LBR$C_TYP_USRLW = 0x80
LBR$C_UPDATE = 0x2

# $LHIDEF
LHI$B_NEXTRFA = 0x4c
LHI$L_CREDAT = 0x30
LHI$L_FREEBLK = 0x48
LHI$L_FREEIDX = 0x5c
LHI$L_FREEVBN = 0x44
LHI$L_FREIDXBLK = 0x58
LHI$L_HIPREAL = 0x60
LHI$L_IDXBLKS = 0x64
LHI$L_IDXCNT = 0x68
LHI$L_LIBSTATUS = 0x7c
LHI$L_MAJORID = 0x8
LHI$L_MAXLUHREC = 0x74
LHI$L_MHDUSZ = 0x70
LHI$L_MINORID = 0xc
LHI$L_MODCNT = 0x6c
LHI$L_NEXTVBN = 0x54
LHI$L_NINDEX = 0x4
LHI$L_NUMLUHREC = 0x78
LHI$L_TYPE = 0x0
LHI$L_UPDHIS = 0x40
LHI$L_UPDTIM = 0x38
LHI$T_LBRVER = 0x10
